plan.problem: The completed PUMPOKO 02 game is published to itch.io but the repository's canonical works/pumpoko path still points at the older original, and the town catalog has no PUMPOKO game entry.
plan.currentContract: Existing original game is at works/pumpoko, new five-stage game is at works/pumpoko-02, the town loads embedded works by data/works.js identity, and historical tests reference immutable Git commit paths. The lifecycle registry preserves identity and path.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Merely renaming two folders would break current test path reads, world consistency Actions, standalone ZIP exporter, and shared direct staging links; it would not install Town Ready / Guide Ready / ghost / update metadata.
plan.design: Move the two complete Git trees by object SHA, adapt only path-bound test inputs and the packaging workflow, provide works/pumpoko-02 as a same-site redirect, preserve the original game in works/pumpoko-01, and use existing Leisure Center embedded player plus guide, ghost, update and search metadata without changing shared runtimes.
plan.migration: The existing works/pumpoko and works/pumpoko-02 lifecycle IDs retain their stable registered paths. After moving content, works/pumpoko is new canonical game; works/pumpoko-02 becomes redirect; works/pumpoko-01 is a newly registered active archive. Immutable historical Git reference paths stay unchanged.
plan.compatibility: No changes to physics, drawing, audio samples or engines. Existing itch.io upload remains unaffected. New game is available from works/pumpoko, old game from works/pumpoko-01; old 02 URL redirects preserving path site prefix, query and hash.
plan.promotionRisk: Changing directory paths and Actions CI affects staging workflows; this is not a production release and cannot be used to auto-promote. Mobile iframe input/audio, future OGP art and production release gates remain pending.
